rationale: The relevant historical defect is the indexed write in the data-entry loop (`positions[i]` rather than the loop-local `positions[j]`), whereas the shown fixed fragment does not introduce any behavior described by the Logic section. The Logic describes record opening, string reads, compatibility-dependent fields, error handling, logging, and closure; it does not specify how the two position values are stored or indexed. Its claims are therefore either shared behavior or abstract enough to be silent on the vulnerable/fixed delta.
